name: Tag Browser
description: Adds a "Tag Browser" channel that shows your library as a folder tree. Tags are split on a separator (default ":") into nested folders, so "move: cambre" appears under move > cambre. Optional branches by date and library folder, and by any Jellyfin property you choose: genres, studios, production year, rating, people by role (for example directors), or what is in the file (video codec, audio language). Any branch can also be promoted to a channel of its own, and the main channel can be hidden. Videos only.
overview: Browse your library as a tree of tags, dates, folders and any metadata
